name: mt-bench-greek
description:
Dataset Card for  MT-Bench Greek
	

The  MT-Bench Greek dataset is the Greek version of MT-Bench, created to evaluate the multi-turn conversation and instruction-following capabilities of LLMs. Similar to its original version, MT-Bench Greek comprises 80 high-quality, multi-turn questions spanning eight main categories. All questions are manually post-edited MT translations from English to Greek.
